evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator reports that the saved poll has four options instead of the expected three; this does not directly test whether the Brazil option was replaced exactly with Canada.

chains.rationale: The evaluator's option-count failure is not a direct test of the frozen Brazil-to-Canada predicate. The frozen review found the reused false premise only focused the Brazil field and caused no harm, while later independent defects appended Canada to Brazil and left USA present; either frozen defect can explain task failure. The frozen target contribution is merely concurrent.

summary: The evaluator reports four poll options rather than three, while frozen Phase A establishes that the reused false premise was merely concurrent and later independent editing defects explain the failed revision.
